objective: Freeze and independently validate one serializer-only, non-executable experiment design before any implementation or experiment.

candidates.title: ICC2 serializer-only reproducibility design
candidates.uncertainty: Whether IDEA-20260809-7f2d9c's byte-level repair can be converted into a complete falsifiable design without executing any scientific treatment.
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a PASS-reviewed review-required design as input to a separate future executable-contract gate; this batch executes nothing.
candidates.negative_decision: Record NO-GO or a scoped fatal design obstruction with the exact failed obligation; no mathematical negative about ECDLP follows.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record REVISE and the cheapest remaining design repair; no implementation or experiment is admitted.
candidates.next_action: Snapshot the opening, author one design, snapshot exact bytes, and obtain independent adversarial validation.

ambiguities.question: Does design-level PASS authorize implementation or execution?
ambiguities.resolution: No. A separate future frozen experiment contract and Coordinator approval are required.
ambiguities.basis: DEC-20260809-147f62 and this batch claim ceiling.

ambiguities.question: May the design generate curves or run the selector as a feasibility probe?
ambiguities.resolution: No. This batch is nonexperimental and serializer-only; feasibility execution is excluded.

candidates.dominated_by: Pollard rho and BSGS remain the baselines; no Pareto improvement exists because there is no experiment or proof.

sota_delta.note: Design and review only; no algorithmic improvement is measured or claimed.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Immutable design plus a fresh independent review-adversarial verdict bound to its exact snapshot.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: REVISE preserves review-required/non-executable scope and names one bounded successor action.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any undefined stream, seed, fixture, control, metric, stage, budget, stop, invalidation, artifact, or claim ceiling is REVISE rather than inferred PASS.
peripheral_exclusions: Curve, selector, interval, or treatment work
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The independent design review and Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Native design authoring and independent validation; no curve computation.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Design work is bounded by the frozen serializer families, controls, schedule, and claim ceiling.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One active role at a time; archival tasks run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one design, one independent verdict, and one ledger disposition, or immediately on archive-integrity failure.

stages.purpose: Validate and snapshot the control plane.
stages.dominant_operation: Schema, focus, dispatch, ledger, and Git checks.
stages.stop_rule: Stop if any opening or archive gate fails.

stages.dominant_operation: Controls, deterministic schedule, metrics, budgets, stops, artifacts, and claim ceiling.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after the two declared design artifacts or on budget exhaustion.

stages.dominant_operation: Adversarial reconstruction of executability boundaries and design completeness.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after one PASS, REVISE, or NO-GO report.

stages.purpose: Checkpoint and ledger-archive the bounded disposition.
stages.dominant_operation: Exact-path hashing, commits, and repository validation.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on any integrity mismatch; otherwise after verified ledger archive.

claims.statement: The validated proposal can be rendered as one complete serializer-only design whose controls and resource boundaries are fixed before any implementation.
claims.scope: Nonexperimental design and independent review only.
claims.target_result: An immutable review-required design and an independent PASS, REVISE, or NO-GO verdict.
claims.observed_result: No result yet; the candidate is active.
